text.p: These are the leading stories in the Moroccan press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Finance Minister Mohamed Kabbaj elaborates on Morocco's business opportunities at London conference on investment in the Mediterranean.
- Moving ceremony for the burial of Moroccan girl Loubna Benaissa in northern city of Tangier.
- Interior Minister Driss Basri underlines need to upgrade public hygiene by amending law and restructuring the sector.
- Liberalisation of wheat imports might endanger agriculture sector.
- Moroccan girl Loubna Benaissa, killed in Belgium, is buried in Tangier in presence of officials of both countries.
- French newspaper Le Monde found guilty of offending King Hassan.
- Interior Minister Driss Basri meets governors over next elections.
- Farmers worried by good weather, as this year's rainfalls so far are not enough to guarantee good harvest.
